content.label: Overcast has been the best podcast player on iOS for a long time now. The dev is clearly a big podcast connoisseur themself, and Overcast has a well-tuned feature set that lets me listen exactly how I want to, with different inboxes prioritization, streaming, and re-run skipping. They were one of the first apps with dynamic silence-shortening and voice-boosting to and they’re still the best at it. To get podcasts the way you want, sounding their best, pick Overcast

I relied on Overcast for my podcasts, but I just updated to find it freezing on me consistently every time I launch it. Fortunately I have the OPML file for my podcasts so I don’t have to go trawling through another app trying to remember all my shows, but still a let-down.  

(Also, if the ‘automated transcript’ is AI generated, which I assume, then not having an opt-out of AI features is a big no for me. Down with AI slop!)

a decent enough player but why does it ALWAYS return the "all" selection I prefer to "current"? It's maximum annoying the developer chose to do this. Please save the preference. When the user selects all that's what rhe user wants from then on.
Apple takes too long to download.
A great app always getting better. The new features I didn’t know I needed but are now essential — like chapter selection. My most-used app.

If there is a committed app to play and organise your podcasts you have found it!

Little hack advice: stop playing at the end of each podcast in the setting is the power user hack!

ONE THING REALLY GRINDS MY GEARS.
You start a new podcast, it starts downloading, and you have cell service or WiFi so the episode plays anyway. But when you fast forward through the first 1-2 minutes of a podcast, usually an introduction or ads, and the download hasn’t loaded the first 1-2 minutes yet, the app fast forwards you to ANOTHER EPISODE. This drives me absolutely crazy. 

Otherwise great app.

title.label: Custom Playlists Didn’t Work For Me

content.label:
Important to say I hate the default Apple podcast so was excited by the rave reviews and passionate single developer backstory.

I had one simple need - different playlists which this is meant to support. I don’t know why this isn’t in apple - I feel like different listens on different days, this can’t be unusual.

Anyway off I went, installed set my basic settings and I created my History and Current Affairs playlist. Populated it with episodes by zipping back and forward from the Apple App. But of a pain but light was at the end of the tunnel.

So far impressed despite it being a little clunky I created my Drama playlist. Open it and it had all the episodes from my history playlist already populated. Odd I thought, oh well and then deleted them. Added a few drama podcasts. Went back to my History playlist. It was now my Drama playlist with a different title.

I decided to try again and found the Appear in Playlist Setting. Set one to drama, set one to News. Added episodes to Drama. Found them in News. Went back to the podcast and the found in setting hadn’t saved. Changed it again. Repeated the process and this time it did work.

Also the episodes in the Lovecraft Investigations were not in Season Order. Season 1 appears all the way down after Season 3 which I only knew from the Apple App.

My experience so far fairly buggy. Feels like I need both apps but considering the experience will probably skip this as don’t want to build lists only to find them needing to be rebuilt

I’m on iPhone 16 maybe it works for everyone else but this functionality didn’t work for me.

It had taken me a while to get to grips with the redesign. I'd finally made my peace with it and created a number of playlists. It was working okay, and then they move the goalposts again with this new hard episode limit...

It makes no sense, the previous logic was actually smarter: you decide on the limit for automatic downloads, and if you want to add more, you can. You're in control. With the new logic, whatever you set as the limit is hardcoded, and if you want to download another episode you can't unless you disable the limit entirely, which breaks automatic downloads for that episode unless you fiddle with the (already super fiddly) settings for every individual podcast before and after downloading.

Who does this help? Who thought this was a good idea? If there really is a use case, why not make it an optional setting rather than breaking everybody's playlists?
I've used Overcast from the start. Highly recommended.

title.label: Episode Limits totally breaks a one time great

content.label: I have used overcast for 11 years. However it is now unusable. I set episode limits to make sure my storage isn’t eaten up by automatic downloads, and I’d always have the latest eps available for me. Anything I manually downloaded or partially listened to did not count against this limit. Not any more. Massively disappointed and sadly have to go looking for a different player.
Smart speed, undo seek, replay podcast, transcripts - all amazing features plus it’s a well designed bloat free app

title.label: Please revert the episode limit change or provide an option

content.label: I’m very sorry to do this, but as John has said on many an ATP, this is one of the few levers I have. This change, and especially the constant full app takeover that I can’t get rid of without deleting episodes I really wish not to, is infuriating. How did this get through the beta without one person in even a vaguely similar position. I will happily update this review if this can be fixed. I’m also sending a feedback. 🙏

title.label: The Best Podcast App on IOS

content.label: I’ve been using this app for years, I recently tried the Apple Podcasts app and it didn’t compare.  If you love podcasts you owe it to yourself to try Overcast - you won’t be disappointed.

title.label: Once-great app feels vibe-coded and brings flaws to the fore

content.label: Per my original review, was “highly intuitive to discover, sample, subscribe to and play podcasts”, “easy on the eye” and “potentially addictive”. But seven years is a long time in tech, and bloat has since set in. Podcasting has now matured to the point where player core functionality is easy to nail down. Five tabs ought to do it: Suggested (by OvercastGPT); Subscribed; Played; Saved; Disliked. Marco (nice engaging chap with heart and head in right places) and Overcast needed a step back and refresh, but this release rather misses the mark. In recent months, various features work and then stop working - almost as though the code itself were non-deterministic, somehow…
Downloaded the app but there’s no podcasts. Search returned nothing! So I deleted it 🤷‍♂️
Used this app for years now, does all the automations you would expect, makes podcast management simple.
Fabulous app. Looks good, easy to use and has some great features like transcription, voice boost and silence shortening.

This has been my go to podcast app for years due to great intuitive interface etc. lately however it has been freezing on startup, as if it’s temporarily offline, and even downloaded eps just won’t play without a 30 second freeze/ delay. Not sure why this has started, but it’s getting frustrating.
A recent update (?) has made the app totally unresponsive. The record is about 30 seconds from selecting the episode to it actually starting…

title.label: Much better than spotify for podcasts

content.label: easier to organise and clear playlists. good sleep timer. if i had one qualm, it’d be that the screen auto locks when reading transcriptions. i know it’s possible to allow it to stay on, as they do on spotify, youtube etc. so i’d like to be able to read transcripts without needing to tap the screen every minute.
Just that really Nice looking too Simple to use and always reliable

title.label: Once a good app, now unusable

content.label: Will occasionally just start playing seemingly random, half-finished episodes of a podcast, rather than the episode you selected. This will sometimes happen when you initially play a podcast, and sometimes while skipping forwards and backwards. Completely unusable.
Do not waste your time
Amazing player. Would love ability to skip adverts automatically if possible

title.label: Made the right choice over a decade ago

content.label: I’ve spent a year on the ~other side~ with Pocket Casts and let’s just say after two minutes listen to the SAME podcast I remembered why I bought in back in the ancient times. Instantly better sound because Marco builds in a little audio processing to stop those nasally peaks in some voices blasting your ears. I don’t even remember why I thought I’d try another podcast app, probably just seeing lots of people complaining about the UI change. Since it’s clearly evidenced you can make a difference with real human reviews, I’m leaving one.
The queue function is so much more intuitive than Apple Podcasts. Love this app
Transcriptions!!!!!! AMAZING!
The transcription feature is absolutely fantastic, I love it.
Wow love transcript navigation after first try. Wonderful idea !

title.label: Great replacement for the stock podcast app

content.label:
A great podcast app becomes donation/shareware so is now free to download and try until your conscious gets the better for you and you throw the dev some cash.

What do you gain over the podcasting app that came with your iPhone/ipod -  much better control over playback speed, a vocal boost option and at the ability to shorten pauses when people are speaking.
I’ve tried all the iOS clients, but always come back to this.

I don't typically write reviews, but feel compelled to for this one. Absolutely amazing -- above and beyond in its versatility, ease of use and friendly UI. There's one additional feature that I'd really love...and would be so thankful for! When looking at a specific podcast's episodes (list of "All" and "Current"), it'd be great if I could filter them -- played vs unplayed. Could go fancier too (played, unplayed, started, starred, or additional sort functions; e.g. by amt of time left, within a particular range of dates, etc). But really just a simple played vs unplayed filter would be amazing. Thanks Marco!!
I’ve used Overcast for several years.  The main features that suit my listening style is speed, extensive catalogue, skip intro/outro and the’nitpicky settings’.  Highly recommended 👌🏼
I love listening to podcast but wanted something that wasn’t cluttered and didn’t track everything I do! Overcast is just that. Excellent work!

title.label: As perfect as can be reasonably expected.

content.label: Overcast has always been by far the best podcast app on iOS. I’ve been using it since it came out in 2014. It’s the first reason I think of as to why I don’t want to go back to Android. When Marco re-wrote the app there were some notable issues but over the last couple of years he’s damn near perfected it.

title.label: Why has the interface become so bad?

content.label: Why can I no longer add podcasts? Do I have too many? Or is this a premium function now? Why has the interface become so bad?
There is no better podcast app. Period.

Overcast has been my go-to podcast player since April 2022. It’s “Smart Speed” feature is a game changer, seamlessly shortening silences without making the audio sound distorted. I also love “Voice Boost,” which makes every episode crystal clear even in noisy environments. The interface is clean, intuitive, and much more reliable than the native Apple Podcasts app. I would be lost without it.

The “Late Night” EQ setting in the iPad/iPhone Music settings is highly effective for podcasts, as it acts as a dynamic range compressor. It makes quiet sounds louder and loud sounds quieter, effectively boosting dialogue and evening out volume spikes.
Slick design, does what I need it to with options to alter things (love the nitpicky details!). Streaming working so much better lately too!

Exasperated with Apples podcast app? 
Then use this one instead - it is well thought out and does what it should. 
I’ve been using it for some time, and it is getting better and better.
Thanks Overcast
Long term user of overcast and it still keeps getting better!

Brilliant app. Well designed. Updates are actually useful. It gets better each update. Better than pretty much all other podcast apps. Check out their other apps, you won’t be disappointed. Forecast anyone??

title.label: The best of a terrible bunch

content.label: This is the best podcast app for iPad, but that's not a particularly high bar. Why are they all so dreadful? This one at least has sort options and a play queue, which are very welcome features. But why does it start playing random episodes when it gets to the end of the queue? Why can't I just add things to the queue and have them play in the order I add them and then stop? Oh sometimes I can, then sometimes I can't. Why can't I hide played episodes? Why does it switch from "All" to "Current" when I rotate the iPad? All these seem like such basic failures it makes me think nobody who writes it actually uses it.
Simultaneously a comfort show and a story that will rip your heart out, chew it up, and fart it back out at you. My favourite actual play podcast, no one else is doing what these guys are doing.

Since the big update and visual overhaul, Overcast becomes the best podcast player again. The biggest fix is the battery drain issue which is no longer present. This caused me to stop using the app previously The app now uses battery very efficiently. 

Awesome app. Great features and great developer.


One gripe…the Apple watch app is poor. Very confusing and slow to download episodes.
Thought I would try this app on my iPhone 13 because I find the Apple Podcast app frustrating to use. However, no podcasts are listed and searching finds nothing.
Amazing - especially since they introduced the searchbar to search within podcasts and the better sorting buttons. A pleasure to use! 💖

title.label: Not working for me any more

content.label:
I have been a passionate supporter of this app for maybe 10 years.  I love the UI and the playback audio features.  But lately it has been driving me nuts !
Two principal problems : Firstly the app will not download new podcasts despite the ‘Automatic’ setting … I keep getting the ‘Waiting to Download’ message for a long time (and there are no problems with my broadband).  Second problem then shows itself … if I click Play, to stream a podcast, it will play for exactly 60 seconds, then stop … press play again and it will run for another 60 seconds and stop again, until the whole episode has downloaded (and did I say that this often takes a long time).
So sadly, unless something changes I won’t be renewing my annual subscription when it comes due !

This used to be a good app but has really fallen down since the latest redesign. 

Downloads fail randomly; it feels like it takes more steps to do simple tasks (like adding episodes to a queue) than it used to; the Apple Watch app is quite frankly a mess. And to top it off the subscription price has gone up. I used to be a subscriber for nearly 10 years but have cancelled this now and will make do with the free version. 

Ultimately it seems another case of shouldn’t have fixed what wasn’t broken… shame.
